targets.root_selector:
# Newest same-run snapshot of one collector component's numeric fields
# (worker_timing or metabase_probe). [{"key":"age_seconds","label":"Age"},{"key":"status","label":"Last run"},{"key":"type","label":"Type"},{"key":"log_retention_days","label":"PITR"}] is a list of
# {key, label, scale?, state_key?}: scale multiplies (epoch seconds to ms);
# state_key names a same-run state field whose 0 (failed) turns the value into -1
# and whose 2 (overdue) turns it into -2, so the panel maps them to words; a missing
# state sample makes the value null (No report) rather than an unqualified age.
# Missing, negative, non-integer, stale (> 360 s) or future (> 120 s) samples are
# null, never zero. Provider errors and truncation fail visibly.
def stamp: sub("[.][0-9]+Z$"; "Z") | fromdateiso8601;
if .error then error("Monitoring query failed")
elif .nextPageToken then error("Collector response truncated; shorten the time range")
else
  [.timeSeries[]? | {field: .metric.labels.field, p: (.points | sort_by(.interval.endTime) | last)} |
    select(.p != null)] as $rows |
  ([$rows[].p.interval.endTime] | max) as $end |
  (try ($end | stamp) catch null) as $t |
  ($t != null and now - $t <= 360 and $t - now <= 120) as $fresh |
  def value($key):
    ([$rows[] | select(.field == $key and .p.interval.endTime == $end)] | first | .p.value.int64Value) as $raw |
    (try ($raw | tonumber) catch null) as $v |
    if $fresh and $v != null and $v >= 0 and ($v | floor) == $v then $v else null end;
  [[{"key":"age_seconds","label":"Age"},{"key":"status","label":"Last run"},{"key":"type","label":"Type"},{"key":"log_retention_days","label":"PITR"}][] as $f |
    (value($f.key)) as $v |
    {key: $f.label,
     value: (if $v == null then null
             elif $f.state_key != null and value($f.state_key) == null then null
             elif $f.state_key != null and value($f.state_key) == 0 then -1
             elif $f.state_key != null and value($f.state_key) == 2 then -2
             else $v * ($f.scale // 1) end)}] |
  from_entries
end

(if .error then error("SQL uptime query failed") elif .nextPageToken then error("Truncated SQL uptime response") else
  (.timeSeries // []) as $s |
  if any($s[]; .metric.type!="custom.googleapis.com/mw_resource_monitoring/worker_timing" or
      .metric.labels.component!="cloud_sql_prod" or .resource.type!="gce_instance" or
      .resource.labels.project_id!="clever-oasis-508610-n7" or .resource.labels.instance_id!="8223265527494214160" or

  then error("Unexpected SQL uptime resource") else
    [$s[]|{field:.metric.labels.field,p:(.points|sort_by(.interval.endTime)|last)}] as $rows |
    if ([$rows[]|.field]|unique|length)!=($rows|length) then error("Ambiguous SQL uptime fields") else
      ($rows|map(select(.field=="status"))|first|.p) as $p |

      (try ($p.interval.endTime|sub("[.][0-9]+Z$";"Z")|fromdateiso8601) catch null) as $t |

    end

panels.title: Debian VM disk

panels.description: Elapsed time since Compute Engine VM start, shown in days, hours and minutes. Source: uptime_total GAUGE for vm-mw-credit-agent, sampled every 60 seconds with up to 120 seconds visibility delay. This is VM-start uptime, not service availability or guaranteed guest-reboot age. Uses the latest raw sample without extrapolation. Samples older than 6 minutes, more than 2 minutes in the future, missing or invalid are Unknown. Query errors remain visible. Historical ranges excluding fresh data are Unknown. Display floors to whole minutes; raw seconds retained internally.

targets.root_selector:
if .error then error("Uptime query failed") elif .nextPageToken then error("Truncated uptime response") else
  (.timeSeries // []) as $series |
  if ($series|length)>1 then error("Ambiguous VM uptime series")
  elif ($series|length)==0 then {Uptime:null}
  elif $series[0].metric.type!="compute.googleapis.com/instance/uptime_total" or
    $series[0].resource.type!="gce_instance" or
    $series[0].resource.labels.project_id!="clever-oasis-508610-n7" or
    $series[0].resource.labels.instance_id!="8223265527494214160" or
    $series[0].resource.labels.zone!="asia-southeast1-a"
  then error("Unexpected uptime resource") else
    [$series[0].points[]?] | sort_by(.interval.endTime) | last as $p |
    (try ($p.interval.endTime|sub("[.][0-9]+Z$";"Z")|fromdateiso8601) catch null) as $t |
    (try ($p.value.int64Value|tonumber) catch null) as $v |
    {Uptime:(if $t!=null and now-$t<=360 and $t-now<=120 and
      $v!=null and ($v|type)=="number" and $v>=0 and ($v|floor)==$v
      then $v else null end)}
  end end | . + {UptimeText:(if .Uptime==null then null else
  (.Uptime/60|floor) as $m | (($m/1440|floor)|tostring)+"d "+
  ("0"+((($m%1440)/60|floor)|tostring)|.[-2:])+"h "+
  ("0"+(($m%60)|tostring)|.[-2:])+"m" end)}
